caption: The drawing shows a single, clear blue-tinted glass jar, positioned upright and centrally on a plain, off-white background. The jar is cylindrical with a threaded neck for a screw cap, and it is depicted with transparent qualities and light reflections on its surface. Embossed text appears on the front of the jar, reading "MASON'S PATENT NOV 30TH 1858" in three distinct lines. The letters are raised and rendered in a slightly darker blue to indicate depth. There is a small orange mark near the top right corner of the drawing and a faint artist's signature in the lower left corner. No other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Mason Jar
